name: Sample grid
instructions: Generic example: replace the targets, the inventory, the scales and the examples with your own (the dashboard's Scoring settings, or this file).
Targets: back-end web development (PHP, APIs, integration), any contract type.
Flag in "gaps" any pay below the floor, a long commute, or a spoken foreign language required at interview.

criteria.label: Technical fit
criteria.description: Skills asked for compared with the inventory: high if the core of the job is at a strong level, low if the main stack is at level none. List the gaps in the justification.

criteria.label: Remote work and commute
criteria.description: Calculated from the number of days on site per week.

criteria.label: Pay
criteria.description: Calculated: gross annual salary in thousands, or day rate, compared with the floor and the high target.

criteria.label: Role and seniority
criteria.description: Level of the role consistent with the experience; lower it for a junior role or for compulsory people management.

criteria.label: Interest
criteria.description: Sector, product, target customer, new technologies to learn.

criteria.label: Process risk
criteria.description: 10 = no risk. Lower it for a live coding test on an unfamiliar stack, or a spoken foreign language required.

rules.label: On site outside the region, no remote work
rules.description: Presence on site required far from home, with no remote work possible.

examples.title: Senior PHP Developer (example)
examples.conditions: Permanent, 1 day on site, 58-65K a year

technique.justification: PHP, REST APIs, MySQL: strong level; Docker required (medium)

risque.justification: Technical test on an existing project

examples.comment: Good job ad: strong technical fit, almost fully remote, salary within the target.

examples.title: Java Developer (example)
examples.conditions: Permanent, remote (days not stated), salary not stated

technique.justification: Java, Spring, Kubernetes: main stack at level none

examples.comment: Off target: technical fit at the bottom, below the threshold despite the neutral values.

examples.title: Web Developer Internship (example)
examples.comment: The blocking rule "stage" (internship) sets the score to 0.
